proposed_widenings.name: create_passage
proposed_widenings.justification: Passwall creates a traversable void/opening through an existing solid surface. This is categorically distinct from create_object (which produces new matter), alter_item_kind (which relabels an object's rules kind without carrying spatial dimensions or occupant-eject semantics), and block_travel (which restricts movement). A passage through existing solid matter requires its own atom carrying width/height/depth dimensions and the material surface it pierces.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A passage appears at a point that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, ceiling, or floor) within range and lasts for the duration. You choose the opening's dimensions: up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep.

proposed_widenings.name: ObjectMaterial: stone | wood | plaster
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell targets a wooden, plaster, or stone surface. OBJECT_MATERIALS currently only contains 'metal' and 'flammable'. Passwall's material gate cannot be expressed without adding the three relevant materials (or a structural-material category).
proposed_widenings.evidence: on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, ceiling, or floor)

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger or lifecycle: eject_occupants_on_expire
proposed_widenings.justification: When the passage disappears, any creatures or objects still inside are safely ejected to the nearest unoccupied space. This is a spatial-cleanup lifecycle effect tied to the spell's expiry, not a target-action-driven early end. None of the existing DurationEndTrigger variants (target_makes_attack_roll, target_deals_damage, etc.) cover this. The closest is a new trigger or a lifecycle atom for 'eject occupants when the host object-effect expires'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When the opening disappears, any creatures or objects still in the passage created by the spell are safely ejected to an unoccupied space nearest to the surface on which you cast the spell.

notes: The spell's payload family (activation or ongoing_effect on an object attachment, timed 1-hour non-concentration duration) fits the existing surface grammar cleanly. The blocking gap is the core effect atom: no atom in v4 or types.ts covers creating a traversable opening/void in existing solid matter. Using alter_item_kind with an opaque newKind string would produce a dishonest trace and is rejected. The material filter and eject-on-end are secondary gaps that matter once the primary atom exists.
